title: उत्तरपर्व · अध्याय १८४

items.text:
॥ श्रीकृष्ण उवाच ॥ ॥
शय्यादानं प्रवक्ष्यामि तव पांडुकुलोद्वह ॥
यद्दत्त्वा सुखभागी स्यादिह लोके परत्र च ॥ १ ॥
items.tr:
|| śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || ||
śayyādānaṃ pravakṣyāmi tava pāṃḍukulodvaha ||
yaddattvā sukhabhāgī syādiha loke paratra ca || 1 ||

items.text:
शय्यादानं प्रयच्छंति सर्वदैव द्विजोत्तमाः ॥
अनित्यं जीवितं यस्मात्कोन्यः पश्चात्प्रदास्यति ॥ २ ॥
items.tr:
śayyādānaṃ prayacchaṃti sarvadaiva dvijottamāḥ ||
anityaṃ jīvitaṃ yasmātkonyaḥ paścātpradāsyati || 2 ||

items.text:
तावत्स बंधुः स पिता यावज्जीवति भारत ॥
मृतो मृत इति ज्ञात्वा क्षणात्स्नेहो निवर्तते ॥ ३ ॥
items.tr:
tāvatsa baṃdhuḥ sa pitā yāvajjīvati bhārata ||
mṛto mṛta iti jñātvā kṣaṇātsneho nivartate || 3 ||

items.text:
तस्मात्स्वयं प्रदातव्यं शय्याभोज्यजलादिकम् ॥
आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरिति संचिंत्य चेतसि ॥ ४ ॥
items.tr:
tasmātsvayaṃ pradātavyaṃ śayyābhojyajalādikam ||
ātmaiva hyātmano bandhuriti saṃciṃtya cetasi || 4 ||

items.text:
आत्मैव यो हि नात्मानं दानभोगैः समर्चयेत् ॥
कोऽन्यो हिततरस्तस्मात्कः पश्चात्पूजयिष्यति ॥ ५ ॥
items.tr:
ātmaiva yo hi nātmānaṃ dānabhogaiḥ samarcayet ||
ko'nyo hitatarastasmātkaḥ paścātpūjayiṣyati || 5 ||

items.text:
तस्माच्छय्यां समासाद्य सारदारुमयीं दृढाम् ॥
दंतपत्रचितां रम्यां हिमपट्टैरलंकृताम् ॥ ६ ॥
items.tr:
tasmācchayyāṃ samāsādya sāradārumayīṃ dṛḍhām ||
daṃtapatracitāṃ ramyāṃ himapaṭṭairalaṃkṛtām || 6 ||

items.text:
हंसतूलीप्रतिच्छन्नां सुभगां सोपधानिकाम् ॥
प्रच्छादनपटीयुक्तां गंधधूपाधिवासिताम् ॥ ७ ॥
items.tr:
haṃsatūlīpraticchannāṃ subhagāṃ sopadhānikām ||
pracchādanapaṭīyuktāṃ gaṃdhadhūpādhivāsitām || 7 ||

items.text:
तस्यां संस्थापयेद्धैमं हरिं लक्ष्मीसमन्वितम् ॥
उच्छीर्षके धृतं चैव कलशं परिकल्पयेत् ॥ ८ ॥
items.tr:
tasyāṃ saṃsthāpayeddhaimaṃ hariṃ lakṣmīsamanvitam ||
ucchīrṣake dhṛtaṃ caiva kalaśaṃ parikalpayet || 8 ||

items.text:
विज्ञेयं पांडव सदा सनिद्राकल्पकं बुधैः ॥
तांबूलं कुंकुमक्षोदकर्पूरागरु चंदनम् ॥ ९ ॥
items.tr:
vijñeyaṃ pāṃḍava sadā sanidrākalpakaṃ budhaiḥ ||
tāṃbūlaṃ kuṃkumakṣodakarpūrāgaru caṃdanam || 9 ||

items.text:
दीपकोपानहच्छत्रचामरासनभोजनम् ॥
पार्श्वेषु स्थापयेच्छक्त्या सप्तधान्यानि चैव हि ॥ १० ॥
items.tr:
dīpakopānahacchatracāmarāsanabhojanam ||
pārśveṣu sthāpayecchaktyā saptadhānyāni caiva hi || 10 ||

items.text:
शयनस्थस्य भवति यदन्यदुपकारकम् ॥
भृंगारकाद्यपुष्पाणि पंचवर्णवितानकम् ॥ ११ ॥
items.tr:
śayanasthasya bhavati yadanyadupakārakam ||
bhṛṃgārakādyapuṣpāṇi paṃcavarṇavitānakam || 11 ||

items.text:
शय्यामेवंविधां कृत्वा ब्राह्मणायोपदापयेत् ॥
सपत्नीकाय संपूज्य पुण्येऽह्नि विधिपूर्वकम् ॥ १२ ॥
items.tr:
śayyāmevaṃvidhāṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇāyopadāpayet ||
sapatnīkāya saṃpūjya puṇye'hni vidhipūrvakam || 12 ||

items.text:
नमस्ते सर्वदेवेश शय्यादानं कृतं मया ॥
देहि तस्माच्छांतिफलं नमस्ते पुरुषोत्तम ॥ १३ ॥
items.tr:
namaste sarvadeveśa śayyādānaṃ kṛtaṃ mayā ||
dehi tasmācchāṃtiphalaṃ namaste puruṣottama || 13 ||

items.text:
यथा न कृष्ण शयनं शून्यं सागरजातया ॥
शय्या ममाप्यशून्यास्तु तथा जन्मनिजन्मनि ॥ १४ ॥
items.tr:
yathā na kṛṣṇa śayanaṃ śūnyaṃ sāgarajātayā ||
śayyā mamāpyaśūnyāstu tathā janmanijanmani || 14 ||

items.text:
दत्त्वैवं तल्पममलं प्रणिपत्य विसर्जयेत् ॥
एकादशाहेऽपि तथा विधिरेष प्रकीर्तितः ॥ १५ ॥
items.tr:
dattvaivaṃ talpamamalaṃ praṇipatya visarjayet ||
ekādaśāhe'pi tathā vidhireṣa prakīrtitaḥ || 15 ||

items.text:
ददाति यदि धर्मार्थं मानवो बांधवे मृते ॥
विशेषं चात्र राजेंद्र कथ्यमानं निबोध मे ॥ १६ ॥
items.tr:
dadāti yadi dharmārthaṃ mānavo bāṃdhave mṛte ||
viśeṣaṃ cātra rājeṃdra kathyamānaṃ nibodha me || 16 ||

items.text:
तेनोपभुक्तं यद्वस्तु किंचित्पूर्वं गृहे सता ॥
तद्गात्रलग्नं च तथा वस्त्रवाहनभाजनम् ॥ १७ ॥
items.tr:
tenopabhuktaṃ yadvastu kiṃcitpūrvaṃ gṛhe satā ||
tadgātralagnaṃ ca tathā vastravāhanabhājanam || 17 ||

items.text:
यदिष्टं च तथास्यासीत्तत्सर्वं परिकल्पयेत् ॥
स एव पुरुषो हैमस्तस्यांतं स्थापयेत्तथा ॥ १८ ॥
items.tr:
yadiṣṭaṃ ca tathāsyāsīttatsarvaṃ parikalpayet ||
sa eva puruṣo haimastasyāṃtaṃ sthāpayettathā || 18 ||

items.text:
पूजयित्वा प्रदातव्यो मृतशय्या यथोदिता ॥
स्वर्गे पुरंदरगृहे सूर्यपुत्रालयेथ वा ॥ १९ ॥
items.tr:
pūjayitvā pradātavyo mṛtaśayyā yathoditā ||
svarge puraṃdaragṛhe sūryaputrālayetha vā || 19 ||

items.text:
सुखं वसत्यसौ जंतुः शय्यादानप्रभावतः ॥
पीडयंति न तं याम्याः पुरुषा भीषणाननाः ॥ २० ॥
items.tr:
sukhaṃ vasatyasau jaṃtuḥ śayyādānaprabhāvataḥ ||
pīḍayaṃti na taṃ yāmyāḥ puruṣā bhīṣaṇānanāḥ || 20 ||

items.text:
न धर्मेण न शीतेन बाध्यते स नरः क्वचित् ॥
अपि पापसमायुक्तः स्वर्गलोके महीयते ॥ २१ ॥
items.tr:
na dharmeṇa na śītena bādhyate sa naraḥ kvacit ||
api pāpasamāyuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate || 21 ||

items.text:
विमानवरमारूढः सेव्यमानोप्सरोगणैः ॥
आभूतसंप्लवं यावत्तिष्ठेत्पातकवर्जितः ॥ २२ ॥
items.tr:
vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sevyamānopsarogaṇaiḥ ||
ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvattiṣṭhetpātakavarjitaḥ || 22 ||

items.text:
शय्याप्रदानममलं तव पांडुपुत्रसंकीर्तितं सकलसौख्यानिधानमेतत् ॥
तयो ददाति विधिवत्स्वयमेव नाके तल्पे विकल्परहितः स विभाति सत्यम् ॥ २३ ॥
items.tr:
śayyāpradānamamalaṃ tava pāṃḍuputrasaṃkīrtitaṃ sakalasaukhyānidhānametat ||
tayo dadāti vidhivatsvayameva nāke talpe vikalparahitaḥ sa vibhāti satyam || 23 ||

items.h: इति श्रीभविष्ये महापुराण  उत्तरपर्वणि श्रीकृष्णयुधिष्ठिरसंवादे शय्यादानविधिवर्णनं नाम चतुरशीत्युत्तरशततमोऽध्यायः ।। १८४ ।।

en_summary: Krishna gives the gift of a bed (shayya-dana), which brings happiness here and hereafter. The best Brahmins always give a bed, for life is uncertain and who will give for one afterwards? A relative or father is one only while he lives; once he is dead, affection ends in a moment, so one should oneself give a bed, food, water and the rest, thinking that one's own self is one's only friend; if one does not honour oneself with gifts and enjoyments, who else will honour one later? A strong bed of hard wood inlaid with ivory and decorated with gold bands, with a swan-down mattress, pillow and coverlet, scented with perfume and incense, is made, and a gold Hari with Lakshmi is placed on it, with a pot of ghee at the head, which the wise call the provision for sleep. Betel, saffron powder, camphor, agaru, sandal, a lamp, shoes, an umbrella, a whisk, a seat, food, the seven grains, a water jug, flowers, a five-coloured canopy and whatever else helps one who lies in bed are set around it. On a holy day, after worshipping a Brahmin and his wife, it is given with the words "Homage to you, lord of all the gods; I have given this bed; give me the fruit of peace; homage to you, Purushottama; as your bed, Krishna, is never empty of Lakshmi, born of the ocean, so may my bed never be empty, birth after birth", and the Brahmin is bowed away. The same rite is done on the eleventh day after a relative's death, when a bed is given for the dead person's dharma; then whatever he used at home, the clothes that touched his body, his vehicle, vessels and whatever he loved are placed with it, and a gold image of the man himself is laid on it, and after worship this "bed of the dead" is given. By the power of the bed gift that person lives happily in heaven, in Indra's house or in Yama's city; Yama's fearsome men do not torment him, he is not troubled by heat or cold, and even if he had sinned he is honoured in heaven, riding a fine chariot served by apsaras, free of sin, until the dissolution of beings. One who gives the bed himself by the rule truly shines in heaven on a bed, free of doubt.
